visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) This live-action video begins with a young woman with dark hair wrapped in a grey towel looking into a mirror while holding a red smartphone. Her face is covered in a thick, white skincare cream. She wears a beige robe with gold trim. The bathroom setting features grey tiled walls and bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up shot of several white receipts printed with Korean text and numeric values, documenting the costs of the medical treatments. Large white and yellow text overlays "1000多萬" and "約20多萬台幣/3人" dominate the frame. The background is a flat green surface with even lighting. (3) A young woman in a pink t-shirt with brown hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit, modern medical clinic with white and pink interior design. She pouts playfully at the camera while clinic staff members work in the background. A hand points to a monitor displaying various treatment prices and data. (4) The main character, wearing a beige turtleneck, speaks directly to the camera in front of neutral curtains. She uses expressive hand gestures and smiles while recommending treatments. Graphic text overlays appear on the left and bottom of the screen to highlight key points and brand names. (5) Close-up shots show a medical professional in white gloves using a handheld microneedling device with a gold-colored tip on a patient's face. Redness is visible on the treated skin. Animated graphics of golden oil droplets appear, followed by a finger pressing into a woman's clear, elastic cheek. (6) A doctor in a white coat and mask is shown performing an injection-style procedure on a patient lying down in a room with pink floral wallpaper. A "before and after" split-screen comparison of an older woman's face is shown, highlighting the reduction in wrinkles and skin sagging. (7) A medical device emitting a bright green light is used on a person's upper thigh to treat skin texture. Comparison photos show the improvement of the skin and the reduction of cellulite. A screenshot of a chat conversation with a laughing emoji is briefly displayed. (8) Interior shots of the "PPEUM Global" clinic show a sleek, modern lobby with pink accents and treatment stations. A smartphone screen displays a LINE chat interface in Traditional Chinese with contact details. The video concludes with the main character waving and blowing a kiss toward the camera.
